scripts.check:upstream: node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const name of ['chord','telemetry','agent','ai','coding-agent']) { const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('upstream/pi/packages/'+name+'/package.json','utf8')); if (pkg.version !== '0.87.1') throw new Error('unsupported upstream '+name+' version: '+pkg.version); }"
scripts.bootstrap:upstream: npm --prefix upstream/pi ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix upstream/pi run hydrate:model-data && npm run build:upstream
scripts.build:upstream: npm run check:upstream && npm --prefix upstream/pi run build --workspace=@earendil-works/chord && npm --prefix upstream/pi run build --workspace=@earendil-works/pi-telemetry && npm --prefix upstream/pi run build:offline --workspace=@earendil-works/pi-ai && npm --prefix upstream/pi run build --workspace=@earendil-works/pi-agent-core && npm run build:auth
